citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 3:20 pm on 8-July-
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door of the home and speaking to the spouse of
the licensee. The licensee's spouse stated that a representative would not be home until late evening and is currently not
available to conduct an inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
